Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a relatively normal mediastinal contour, with the post-operative image (Figure 3a), there is a marked increase in the width of the superior mediastinum. In the context of a known thyroid angiosarcoma, this rapid enlargement of the mediastinal mass is most consistent with aggressive tumor recurrence rather than a stable post-surgical change or hematoma.
